sections.title: The bill
sections.content: The bill is *a számla*. You ask for one specific bill, so use the definite *kérem* and the object ending: *Kérem a számlát.* (A final *-a* lengthens before *-t*.) The waiter answers *Hozom a számlát.* *Hoz* (brings) works like *kér*: *hozok* with *egy* or no article, *hozom* with *a / az*.

sections.title: Total and paying
sections.content: To find out the total, ask *Mennyi összesen?* and the answer is *Összesen ezerötszáz forint.* To pay, say *Fizetek.* The waiter says *Tessék* and you answer *Köszönöm.*

items.english: How much is that in total?

sections.content: The bill is a specific thing both of you know, so it is *a számlát* with *kérem*, never *egy számlát* with *kérek*.
